response.text: {"label": "timing_arithmetic", "reason": "send_byte holds each bit for prescale*CLK_PERIOD ns (prescale cycles) instead of prescale*8 cycles, so the receiver mis-samples both frames and delivers ff instead of 12 and 34 (sub `79 644000 rx hs ff`, `295 2372000 rx hs ff`); the wait for 8'h34 therefore never completes and the run times out."}
